scope: Only MissionController._project and two new private legacy-receipt/record helpers; no action/store/CLI/MCP mutation.
recovery: terminal_build_records_recovery: get current q.records with context, revision and state_sha256; old revisions require journal replay.
receipt_checks: Guarded same-byte hash and JSON; exact pin/path, terminal exit_code integer matching handle; historical running additionally needs terminal receipt and valid start pid. Duplicate JSON keys, NaN, invalid JSON or unreadable receipt keep facts visible.
legacy_only: track_build_r38 schema: running/completed/failed/terminated. Not a universal fact deletion or compaction rule.
future_tracker: Only flow handle deltas; implemented and tested separately by root.
limitations: Mandatory general facts/orders/errata and compact indices can still exceed a requested budget; overflow remains visible refusal.
